technology.title: India's Digital Rupee Is Going International. For NRIs, That Changes Everything.
technology.excerpt: The RBI's annual report reveals cross-border CBDC pilots with Singapore and the UAE — the two corridors that matter most to the Indian diaspora.
technology.nri_angle: Over 4 million Indians live in the UAE and 600,000+ in Singapore — two of the largest remittance corridors to India. A working cross-border digital rupee could slash the cost and time of sending money home, bypassing SWIFT fees and correspondent banking delays that NRIs have endured for decades.

technology.title: Apple's Biggest AI Gamble Is Ten Days Away. An Indian-Origin Engineer Is Calling the Shots.
technology.excerpt: Amar Subramanya, who built Google's Gemini and spent a stint at Microsoft, is now VP of AI at Apple — and WWDC on June 8 will be his first public test.
technology.nri_angle: Amar Subramanya adds to the extraordinary roster of Indian-origin leaders running AI at America's most valuable companies — Pichai at Google, Nadella at Microsoft, and now Subramanya at Apple. For Indian engineers in Silicon Valley, his appointment signals that the pipeline from IIT labs to the C-suite of trillion-dollar companies remains wide open.

technology.title: ASML Just Agreed to Equip India's First Real Chip Factory. Here's What That Actually Means.
technology.excerpt: Tata Electronics' $11 billion Dholera fab signed a strategic partnership with the Dutch lithography monopoly. For Indian semiconductor engineers, this is a zero-to-one moment.
technology.nri_angle: Thousands of Indian-origin engineers work at ASML, TSMC, Intel, and other semiconductor companies globally. The Dholera fab creates a return-to-India pathway for NRI chip professionals — and an investment thesis for those watching India's semiconductor ambitions.

technology.title: Intel's 230% Stock Surge Is the Chip Comeback Nobody Predicted
technology.excerpt: The AI inference boom has turned Intel from Wall Street's punchline into its biggest semiconductor winner of 2026 — and thousands of Indian engineers in Bangalore helped make it happen.
technology.image_caption: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan, whose turnaround has sent Intel shares surging past their dot-com era highs. Photo: Wikimedia Commons
technology.nri_angle: Intel employs over 10,000 engineers in Bangalore and Hyderabad, making it one of the largest employers of Indian chip designers. The CPU inference boom creates massive upside for Indian semiconductor professionals and NRI investors who wrote Intel off.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Wix, Webflow, Cloudflare: AI Just Gutted Three Software Companies in One Week
technology.excerpt: A brutal wave of AI-driven layoffs is reshaping the software industry — and Indian tech workers on H-1B visas have the most to lose.
technology.image_caption: The latest wave of AI-driven layoffs is hitting software companies hardest. Photo: Pexels
technology.nri_angle: Indian H-1B holders at software companies face a 60-day grace period to find new employment or leave the country when laid off. The AI-driven restructuring hitting SaaS and web-platform companies directly threatens the visa status and career stability of thousands of Indian tech workers.

technology.title: Meta Wants You to Pay for WhatsApp. Here's What That Means for 500 Million Indians.

technology.image_caption: Meta's subscription push spans Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp — apps used by hundreds of millions of Indians daily.
technology.nri_angle: WhatsApp is the connective tissue of the Indian diaspora — the family group chat, the money transfer coordination, the NRI grapevine. Any monetization move by Meta here touches every Indian abroad personally. Creator and business tiers also reshape the economics for India's massive influencer and SMB ecosystem.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Anthropic Just Dethroned OpenAI. Its $965 Billion Valuation Makes It Bigger Than Walmart.
technology.excerpt: A $65 billion Series H round makes the Claude maker the world's most valuable AI startup. Revenue has hit $47 billion annualised. An IPO is likely this year. And India is its second-largest market.
technology.image_caption: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei. His company is now valued higher than OpenAI.
technology.nri_angle: Indian engineers and researchers are heavily represented at Anthropic and across AI labs vying for talent. India is Claude's second-biggest market globally. For NRI investors watching the AI space, this valuation reshuffles the landscape ahead of what could be the biggest tech IPO since Meta itself.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: ByteDance Is Designing Its Own CPUs. The AI Chip Shortage Is That Bad.
technology.excerpt: TikTok's parent is pursuing custom processors on both ARM and RISC-V architectures as CPU prices surge 35% and Intel delivery times stretch to six months.
technology.image_caption: The AI boom is no longer just a GPU story — central processors are now the bottleneck.
technology.nri_angle: Indian chip design engineers are among the most sought-after professionals in the semiconductor industry. ByteDance's entry into custom silicon expands the addressable market for this talent. India's own RISC-V push through the India Semiconductor Mission gains relevance as major players validate the open-source architecture.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Chip Stocks Are Having Their Best Year Since the Dot-Com Boom. Sanjay Mehrotra's Micron Just Hit $1 Trillion.
technology.excerpt: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has surged 81% in 2026 — its best first 100 trading days on record. At the centre of the rally: Micron Technology, led by Indian-American CEO Sanjay Mehrotra, which reached a $1 trillion valuation faster than any company in history.
technology.image_caption: Sanjay Mehrotra, CEO of Micron Technology (Wikimedia Commons)
technology.nri_angle: An Indian-origin CEO who was rejected for a US visa three times now leads the fastest company ever to reach $1 trillion. For NRI investors and the thousands of Indian semiconductor engineers at Micron, Intel, AMD, and Broadcom, this rally is both a portfolio event and a career validation.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Jayshree Ullal's Arista Just Posted 35% Growth. The AI Networking Boom Is Only Getting Started.

technology.image_caption: Jayshree Ullal, CEO of Arista Networks (Wikimedia Commons)
technology.nri_angle: Jayshree Ullal, born in London to Indian parents and raised in New Delhi, has turned Arista into a $194 billion company. For Indian network engineers and infrastructure architects across Silicon Valley, her company's AI-driven growth is creating a new wave of high-paying roles.

technology.title: Nadella Is Building Microsoft's Own AI Brain. The OpenAI Divorce Gets Real.
technology.excerpt: Microsoft will unveil homegrown coding, reasoning, and speech models at Build 2026 next week — its clearest signal yet that the $13 billion OpenAI partnership is becoming a backup plan, not the main one.
technology.image_caption: Satya Nadella, CEO of Microsoft (Wikimedia Commons)
technology.nri_angle: Microsoft employs more Indian engineers on H-1B visas than almost any other company. If Nadella's in-house AI pivot reshapes product teams and hiring priorities, tens of thousands of Indian technologists in Redmond and the Bay Area will feel it first.

technology.nri_angle: Dell employs over 25,000 engineers across India in Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Chennai — its largest R&D footprint outside the US. As AI server revenue explodes, the skills demanded at these centers are shifting from traditional enterprise hardware to AI infrastructure, GPU orchestration, and liquid cooling systems. lifestyle-health.title: A Review of 19 Clinical Trials Found That Turmeric With Black Pepper Consistently Lowers Inflammation. Your Grandmother's Haldi Doodh Was Doing More Than You Thought.

lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.excerpt: Two separate studies have found that common genetic variants in South Asian and Black populations artificially lower HbA1c results — the test your doctor uses to diagnose and monitor diabetes. The implications for the Indian diaspora are enormous.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Wildfire Smoke Does Not Just Burn Your Lungs. A Growing Body of Research Says It Is Rewiring Your Brain.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Dementia risk, cognitive decline, and mental illness in children — the neuroscience of wildfire smoke is catching up to what California residents already sense. Indian-Americans in the Bay Area and LA are disproportionately exposed.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Wildfire smoke over a city skyline — fine particulate matter from these events can cross the blood-brain barrier and trigger neuroinflammation.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Trial of 410 Cancer Survivors Found That Four Weeks of Gentle Yoga Reduced Insomnia, Fatigue, and Anxiety. No Medication Required.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The YOCAS programme, presented at ASCO 2026, is built on hatha and restorative yoga — practices that Indian families have known for generations. Western oncology is finally catching up.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: A gentle yoga session — the kind of hatha and restorative practice now shown to significantly reduce insomnia and fatigue in cancer survivors.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Study of 39,000 Women Found That Two Hours of Brisk Walking Per Week Cuts Stroke Risk by 30 Per Cent. Running Did Not Do Better.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The Women's Health Study tracked participants for twelve years. Brisk walking outperformed vigorous exercise for stroke prevention. South Asian women in the US have among the lowest physical activity rates of any demographic group.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Study Found That Coffee Reshapes Your Gut Bacteria and Improves Your Mood. Caffeine Had Nothing to Do With It.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A Nature Communications trial separated 62 adults into coffee drinkers and non-drinkers, then removed coffee for two weeks. When it came back — caffeinated or decaf — stress and depression scores dropped in both groups. The gut-brain axis, not the caffeine, was doing the work.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Review of Every Major Vaping Study Since 2017 Found DNA Damage, Heavy Metals, and Early Cancer Signals. 'Safer Than Cigarettes' Was Never the Same as 'Safe.'
lifestyle-health.excerpt: E-cigarette aerosols contain formaldehyde, nickel, and chromium. Asian-American teens are among the fastest-growing users. Indian-American parents may be the last to notice.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: E-cigarette aerosols contain DNA-damaging compounds including formaldehyde and heavy metals.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Yale Study of 540,000 People Found That Your Body Can Tell the Difference Between Working Hard and Working Out. Only One of Them Protects Your Health.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: New research in Nature Genetics shows leisure-time exercise activates biological pathways that workplace movement and household chores simply cannot replicate. Indian-American professionals are among the most affected.
lifestyle-health.image_caption: Leisure-time exercise — the kind you choose to do — activates biological pathways that workplace movement cannot replicate.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.excerpt: Uttar Pradesh's AYUSH Health and Wellness Policy 2026 is India's most ambitious bet on wellness tourism yet. For NRIs spending $3,000 on a weekend spa in Sedona, the same money in Varanasi will get you a month of traditional medicine with a lineage older than Western civilisation.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Study of 463,000 People Found That Loneliness Raises Your Risk of Heart Valve Disease by 23 Per Cent. Living Alone Does Not. The Distinction Matters More Than You Think.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The largest study of its kind found that feeling lonely — not being socially isolated — independently predicts degenerative valve disease. For a diaspora that prizes stoicism and treats loneliness as weakness, the findings are a clinical alarm bell.
